resources.string: Point your camera at any plant. It hops into a little pot and joins your collection.
Drip the watering can next to a camera and a potted plant
Every walk fills Drip\'s tank with water. Your plants drink every day, and they wilt if you stop walking.
Drip next to water drops and a thirsty potted plant
Walk somewhere new to earn an elixir. One elixir brings a withered plant back to life.
Drip cheering beside an elixir bottle and a map pin
I need the camera so you can snap plants and turn them into cards.
Counting your steps lets every stroll pour water into my tank.
Knowing where you walk, only while the app is open, lets me light up new places on your map.
Drip next to a map pin
I can ping you when a plant gets thirsty, and you can switch it off anytime.
Drip next to a little bell
Reading your daily steps from Health Connect means even walks without the app still water your garden.
Health Connect lets walks without the app water your garden too. Want to grab it?
